title: Cheap in-stock products
prompt: Return the name and price of all in-stock products that cost less than 20.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category TEXT, price REAL, in_stock INTEGER); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Widget','Hardware',9.99,1),(2,'Gadget','Hardware',19.99,0),(3,'Doohickey','Toys',4.50,1),(4,'Thingamajig','Toys',12.00,1),(5,'Contraption','Hardware',25.00,0),(6,'Gizmo','Electronics',49.99,1);
reference_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE in_stock = 1 AND price < 20;
